body: 14 Nov 2026, PART B RESEARCH 2 of 2. DESIGN RECOMMENDED (two PRs, server M and phone M): (1) migration 0010 adds ref_merge(seq, old_id UNIQUE, into_id, at, norm_key, isrc, deezer_id, ytm_video_id, duration_ms); (2) the repair runs automatically at server startup right after database.migrate() (api.py:1456), with its own VACUUM INTO backup, one BEGIN IMMEDIATE, idempotent by its detection query, held pairs logged: not an admin action, a stranger who upgrades needs it; (3) old ids keep working on the server by resolving through ref_merge in set_item, add_entries, record_play, put_state, get_ref, keep, stream-url, saved-album refs (old apps, queued edits); (4) the phone learns through a merges list on the library/files response with its own cursor (not file_log, whose rows are re-pointed); (5) phone: new EncoreWriter.applyMerges called from EncoreSync.pullFiles in the same transaction as upsertRefs: re-point entries and history with a plain UPDATE, downloads/lyrics/pins UPDATE OR IGNORE then delete leftovers and the loser's file, rewrite the queue snapshot (the generic walk in _rekeyQueue :249-267 is reusable), carry the loser's starred_at_ms to the survivor if it lacks it, delete the loser's tracks row (or rename it if the survivor's row is absent). 5 PAIRS HELD (they differ in ytm_video_id; the only pairs with user rows: 17 entries, 13 playlists hold both refs, a merge would put one song twice in 13 playlists): Empire State Of Mind sr_01M6SCE13TZ0FKHHVJ4AP2TQ7R / sr_01M6SFTDENCX13315FSQF8SR41; Lose Yourself sr_01M6SCE13W6NP6FVV60KVJHJE2 / sr_01M6SP3T5JT3EYT57SEXRT6YC1; Paranoid Android sr_01M6TYJHNDQ94MW7ETYCEEPWGC / sr_01M6TYJHNCKCE1SJ8451YC16EG; Rule Of Nines sr_01M6TYJHP81C659NS7YEECK75Y / sr_01M6TYJHPDGXW8KEE8FR7Y8BTK; Darkbloom sr_01M6V34VANR3VPR1DN4Q69VW9C / sr_01M6V34VANKVAHFMYZRYAGYJ27 (Darkbloom has three refs: survivor = the first youtube ref). ROOT CAUSE B, not fixed by part A: the KEEPER shares one file between refs (keeper.py:116 _existing(ref) before downloading; :193 attaches an existing file at the same placement to any ref); after a detach the next keep re-attaches. Different-recording screen: 0 pairs differ by more than 15 s in length, 0 differ in ISRC/Deezer id, 16 pairs differ by 3 to 15 s.
